preserved_assertions: Relocated fixtures retain their prior assertions; no snapshot auto-accept or unique assertion removal.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.
execution.coverage: Every gated real function range requires executable gcov lines; actual-entry controls reject empty, unrelated and partially measured reports without changing behavioral assertions.

gaps: Required contract: complete balanced source pairs, final release and recovery; early release across route changes permitted. All46 Matrix plus17 actual IQS cases are required. Source/sensor/split/physical limits remain separate; IQS NOT RUN without explicit checkout.
Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.
Consumer pause/replacement, source removal, unobserved edges on non-Matrix routes, and earlier asymmetric edge filtering require an end-to-end input/consumer ownership contract.
Arbitrary thread interleavings are not exhaustively proven by the named host/native fixtures.
suppression_extraction: Source buttons are transparent; independent final filter owns pair/repeat/pending-frame policy. Current map and retired-contract boundaries: tests/README.md.
scheduled_work_settings_review: The driver fixture injects replacement before the hold handler's stream lock, with disabled, changed and unchanged long-press settings, and checks the new contact's deadline. The kernel fixture pauses a real running handler at the same unlocked boundary: six retained groups plus three replacement groups, one binary three times/core. DYA additionally enables the actual settings registry and holds two processor nodes: a foreign edit changes neither hold; editing the peer releases only its own claim. The two-node host adapter retains every range/read/reset case and tests every descriptor, foreign events and initialization. Equal public API setter calls still reset their own node; notification dispatch is the isolation boundary. The guarded hold hook is enabled only by the owner kernel fixture.
concurrent_settings: Concurrent notifications are serialized across the complete settings read/apply transaction. The DYA kernel fixture wraps the real registry read to pause writer A after its snapshot, commits writer B on another Zephyr thread, then resumes A. Live values must finish at the registry's latest values. The same before-fix binary fails three times; the fixed DYA fixture runs three times. The wrapper exists only in the owner fixture; production has no settings test hook.

integer_width.production: Geometry/deadline arithmetic uses 32-bit words; timeout results retain the kernel tick ABI. Independent wider oracles remain test-only.
integer_width.contract: Normalized geometry uses bounded uint32 products. Squared travel keeps one explicit carry bit alongside its uint32 low word, retaining exact farthest-point ordering up to the maximum supported coordinates. Hold deadlines use modulo uint32 uptime and explicit armed state, including deadline zero after wrap. Pending deadlines assume elapsed observations below 2^31 ms.
integer_width.fixtures: runtime/geometry_harness.c retains exact large squared-distance and direction/tie assertions using a test-only wide reference. runtime/driver_harness.c adds carry ordering and wrapped/zero/unarmed hold deadlines. Existing generated-key, reset and settings/race assertions remain.

timeout_conversion.contract: Single variable hold-work timeout; full uint16 range, exact ceiling, configured tick ABI, zero-disable and all contact/deadline/generation/output policy retained

fixture.asserts: Actual private hold-timeout header; all 65536 uint16 intervals at 14 rates against an independent wide ceiling oracle, both tick forms, optimized/sanitized/coverage/m32. Four semantic faults require 3 qualified failures per tick form; a numerically correct wide control fails the width guard. Real-kernel fixture also compares actual Zephyr conversions at 7 positive rates without changing existing hold/settings/layer assertions.
